Frequently Asked Questions
Everything parents want to know
What are the most popular Latin baby names?▼
Popular Latin names include Clara, Lucia, Felix, Leo and Julian for both genders. Names like Aurelia, Valeria, Cassius and Maximus are growing fast as parents seek classical elegance.
What do Latin names mean?▼
Latin names often have precise, beautiful meanings. Felix means happy and fortunate, Lux means light, Aurora means dawn, and Aurelius means the golden one.
Are Roman names fashionable?▼
Yes — Roman names are having a major revival. Atticus, Cato, Cassius, Julius and Octavia all feel fresh and distinctive while carrying enormous historical weight.
What are elegant Latin girl names?▼
Elegant Latin girl names include Aurelia, Lavinia, Cornelia, Valeria, Minerva, Cecilia and Cressida — all beautifully classical and ripe for revival.
